title: How a falling cat lands on its feet
pause_note: v5, Animals Explained. WEIRD hook: a cat falling upside down, already starting to turn, at 0 s; wrong guess (1894: it pushed off the hand) at ~4 s; reveal at ~8-9 s: it bends in the middle and turns each half on its own; front half (legs tucked) spins, back barely moves; swap; feet down; stake: from very low there is no time; loop to the upside-down cat; one-word question.

beats: This cat is falling upside down, with nothing to push on.
In 1894, scientists thought it cheated, pushing off the hand.
It did not. It bends in the middle, and turns each half on its own.
Front legs tucked in, the front half spins round, while the stretched-out back barely moves.
Then it swaps, and the back half catches up. Feet down.
But from very low, it runs out of time to turn.
